tokens.name: text-on-brand-secondary

tokens.name: line-hairline
tokens.usage: Seams between the sidebar, panels and content, and dividers.

tokens.name: line-card
tokens.usage: Card and dialog borders.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Outlines of chips, outlined pills and the whisper composer, and the underline of the recorded-history link. Flagged: 2.0:1 on the app background in the dark theme and 1.6:1 in the light one, under the 3:1 for control borders, which is acceptable only because the control's own text identifies it.

tokens.name: line-control-hover
tokens.usage: The same outlines on hover.

tokens.name: line-field
tokens.usage: The outline of a text field: 3:1 against the ground, as a field's boundary needs.

tokens.name: line-focus
tokens.usage: The edge a control shows on keyboard focus: warm, the secondary ink, never blue, and 3:1 on every surface it lands on; never a ring outside the control. A bordered control's own border takes it; a borderless one shows it as a 1 px edge just inside its own box, so nothing moves. A focused text field, editable or held, takes it in its 1 px border and a 1 px inset edge by pointer or keyboard. A segmented control's option with keyboard focus takes it in its 1 px border and a 1 px inset edge, 2 px in all; the chosen option's resting edge is line-field. The composer keeps its own edge.

tokens.name: button-danger-fill

tokens.name: button-danger-fill-hover
tokens.usage: The danger button's fill on hover, status-refused at 24%.

tokens.name: button-danger-text

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: Links and selection. Never a fill behind text, and never a focus edge.

tokens.name: status-handled
tokens.usage: Handled or allowed: a 6 px dot or thin bar beside words that say the same thing.

tokens.name: status-held
tokens.usage: Held, or needs you: a 6 px dot or thin bar beside words that say the same thing.

tokens.name: status-refused

tokens.name: mark-tile
tokens.usage: The Claude Desk mark's white tile, drawn only in the app icon (MarkAppIcon) above the About pages' title. The mark-* colors are the mark's own: fixed, the same in every theme, and used nowhere else.

tokens.name: mark-clay
tokens.usage: The clay dome of the bell in the Claude Desk mark. Fixed, the same in every theme.

tokens.name: mark-ink
tokens.usage: The drawing's dark ink of the bell in the Claude Desk mark (its outline, knob, reflection, sound waves and counter line), on a light ground, the light theme's paper included, and on the mark's tile. Fixed, the same in every theme.

tokens.name: mark-ink-light
tokens.usage: The bell's ink on the dark theme's grounds, where the mark has no tile: the drawing's dark ink drawn light. Fixed, the same in every theme.

tokens.name: mark-hairline
tokens.usage: The hairline edge of the mark's tile in the About pages' app icon. Fixed, the same in every theme. Decorative.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: The field behind the first-visit intro's illustration, the field of the app icon above the About pages' title, which counts as part of the mark, and Claude's writing dots. Nowhere else; the bell's dome has its own clay, mark-clay.

tokens.name: scrim

tokens.name: illustration-card

tokens.name: illustration-line

tokens.name: illustration-handled
tokens.usage: The check and the receipt dots on an intro illustration card.

tokens.name: illustration-arc

tokens.name: qr-tile

tokens.name: qr-ink

tokens.name: connector-stripe

tokens.name: connector-google-blue

tokens.name: shadow-composer
tokens.usage: The composer only. Everything else is set apart by fill and a hairline, except the dialogs and menus that shadow-dialog lifts. Dialog stays flat over the scrim.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Lifts the intro dialog (under its inset hairline), the connector picker and the connector sign-in over the scrim, and the popover menus (an approval's answers, the outcome menu, the preset menu) over the page. Dialog stays flat over the scrim, as its board draws it.

motion.note: Kept in the repo only: the published design system has no motion family, so these ship in its stylesheet.

tokens.name: motion-instant
tokens.usage: Color changes on hover and press.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Press feedback and small state changes.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: A check that draws once, or a reveal.

tokens.name: motion-stagger
tokens.usage: The delay between results that arrive one by one.

tokens.name: motion-settle
tokens.usage: Each new word of Claude's reply settling in as it streams or is revealed; none under reduced motion.

tokens.name: motion-follow
tokens.usage: The beat between a revealed reply's cards, then their receipts, as each fades and rises in after its words; none under reduced motion.

tokens.name: motion-ease
tokens.usage: The default easing.

tokens.name: motion-ease-emphasis
tokens.usage: Easing for the one small moment on a screen.

tokens.name: motion-ease-bounce
tokens.usage: Soft easing in and out for Claude's writing dots' bounce.

tokens.name: motion-breathe
tokens.usage: The slow loop of presence glyphs; static under reduced motion.

tokens.name: motion-writing
tokens.usage: The pulse loop of a person's typing dots and line, and of the band that sweeps a loading page's skeleton; static under reduced motion.

tokens.name: motion-dots
tokens.usage: The gentle bounce loop of Claude's writing dots; static under reduced motion.

tokens.name: motion-spin
tokens.usage: One turn of a busy button's spinner, at an even speed; a still arc under reduced motion.
